answer: Each identity holds a relic bond of 400 units kept alive only by a beacon relay chain: every epoch it must forward a fresh signed pulse across a bridge of three distinct neighbor keys, each neighbor staking 200 units that burn if a pulse is forged or relayed twice. Neighbor sets are recorded on-chain and may overlap by at most one key across a fleet, so an operator running n clones needs 3n distinct bonded neighbors. The relic never resets - reissuing means a new identity at zero trust with a fresh 400-unit bond. C(n) = 400n + 600n in neighbor stakes, linear, no bulk path.
